verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a SaaS data platform with a Connector SDK, MCP server and hybrid agents, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has nothing on disabling telemetry or usage tracking. The 'usage-based pricing' items concern billing metering, not a privacy opt-out, and data-blocking and column-hashing features control customer data being synced, not the product's own telemetry.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
